definition: AI systems that process and combine more than one kind of input or output, such as text, images, audio and video.
details: Multimodal models align different modalities into shared representations so they can caption an image, answer questions about a chart, or generate a video from text. They underpin modern assistants that see, hear and read at once.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is Multimodal AI.

citation.title: Multimodal Machine Learning: A Survey and Taxonomy
